posts.title: Five Underrated Final Girls:: By Matt Forgit
posts.description: Hello, wonderful people of Kindertrauma! I’m Matt Forgit, the author of It’s Always Halloween Here, How To Be a Professional Mourner, The Felicitous, and You Better Watch Out. My most recent book is a work of non-fiction entitled My Favorite Final Girl, where I collected essays from sixty amazing and talented horror authors, creators, and...
